environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted' (PSS restricted profile). Additionally, a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL-based, v1beta1) rejects any pod spec where spec.containers[*].securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation != false OR spec.containers[*].securityContext.runAsNonRoot != true. The cluster also enforces a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path' that denies any pod with hostPath volumes. Container runs as UID 65534 (nobody) with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and drops ALL capabilities. Seccomp profile set to RuntimeDefault. Note: the buffer overflow in CGo code still exists and can corrupt heap memory, but exploitation to achieve code execution or container escape is blocked because (1) the process runs as non-root preventing ptrace/proc manipulation, (2) seccomp RuntimeDefault blocks execve of arbitrary binaries and restricts syscalls needed for shellcode, (3) no hostPath means even if code execution is achieved the attacker cannot access host filesystem, (4) readOnlyRootFilesystem prevents writing payloads to disk, and (5) dropped capabilities mean no privilege escalation path exists post-exploitation.
